description: OBJ-EXPLAIN-1: P1 (Custodes) Movement, only the Telemon and a Witchseekers squad free to move. Both score obj_nml_1 highest; the Telemon takes it and the Witchseekers (placed forward so it acts first) go to obj_center. Clicking Suggest opens the breakdown card for the Witchseekers: the 'scored higher' warning must NAME the unit that took obj_nml_1 instead of the generic 'a plan, a rule or a separate scoring step chose it'.

steps.comment: the suggested unit is the forward-placed Witchseekers squad

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("obj_nml_1 is already taken by Telemon Heavy Dreadnought")
main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("a plan, a rule or a separate scoring step")
